title: Listing outcomes of two events
goal: I can list the outcomes of two events in a table and find probabilities.
teach: When two things happen, list all the possible outcomes, the sample space, in a table or list. Two dice give 6 × 6 = 36 equally likely outcomes. Two coins give HH, HT, TH and TT. Then P(event) = favourable outcomes ÷ 36 (or ÷ 4).

ex.q: Two dice are rolled and the numbers are added. Find P(sum of 7).
steps: There are 36 outcomes in the table.

watch: HT and TH are different outcomes. So are 2 + 5 and 5 + 2.

qs.steps:
1. Rule: list all the outcomes in a table; two dice give 6 × 6 = 36 equally likely outcomes.
2. Only (6; 6) gives 12.
3. P = 136

1. Rule: list all the outcomes in a table; two dice give 6 × 6 = 36 equally likely outcomes.
2. sums of 8: (2;6) (3;5) (4;4) (5;3) (6;2) = 5 outcomes
3. P = 536

qs.text: Two coins are tossed. Find P(two heads).
qs.steps:
1. Rule: two coins give 4 outcomes: HH, HT, TH, TT.
2. P(HH) = 14
